summary.intent: Investigate someguy sidecar status on staging, diagnose IPNS routing failures, upgrade Kubo to v0.40.0, and optimize CI pipeline parallelism.
summary.outcome: Diagnosed someguy's IPNS endpoint as completely non-functional (hangs indefinitely), upgraded Kubo v0.34.0→v0.40.0 with full E2E/load test validation, reverted staging to delegated-ipfs.dev, added build/perf/revert to release-please changelog sections, and parallelized CI pipeline jobs.

repo: Someguy's /routing/v1/providers/ works fine but /routing/v1/ipns/ (GET and PUT) hangs indefinitely — someguy v0.11.1 is the latest stable release, so no version bump available
docker/ directory with compose files is never committed to git — it's generated during CI and SCP'd to the VPS
Release Please only triggers releases for feat and fix commit types by default — build/perf/revert require explicit changelog-sections config in release-please-config.json
The .env file (NODE_ENV=development) overrides shell env vars via NestJS ConfigModule — can't just set NODE_ENV=test in the shell
Throttle bypass requires X-Throttle-Bypass header with THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET — not configured for load test harness by default
CI critical path was fully sequential: changes → typecheck → test → sdk-e2e → build; test/sdk-e2e/build all unnecessarily waited on each other
Grafana Cloud free-tier instance sleeps when idle and returns 503 'Your instance is loading' on wake — dashboard provisioning needs a readiness poll
alloy-config.river had a someguy metrics scrape target that needed removal alongside the service

code.finding: Default fallback is https://delegated-ipfs.dev when DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL env var is not set
build job if condition !failure() && !cancelled() was redundant after removing test/sdk-e2e from needs — simplified to needs: [changes, lint]
test job if condition was redundant after parallelization refactor
sdk-e2e job if condition was redundant after parallelization refactor

workflow: Vitest runs all test files matching a pattern concurrently — --testPathPattern matching multiple files causes all scenarios to run in parallel, overwhelming the target
Load test 'errors' can be SDK-side failures (thrown exceptions) not HTTP errors — high error rates don't necessarily mean API is returning 4xx/5xx
go tool chain version in Kubo v0.40.1 was downgraded from 1.26 to 1.25 specifically to fix Windows memory corruption — not relevant for Linux deployments
Adding lint to needs of typecheck/api-spec/migration-check enables fail-fast behavior before expensive jobs run

friction: Someguy 'disable' from a previous session never persisted — either the .env.staging was overwritten by a subsequent deploy or the change was never committed
NODE_ENV=test in shell doesn't override NestJS ConfigModule which loads .env file — required manually editing .env temporarily
Load test harness missing THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET env var configuration causing 429s during local testing
Vitest testPathPattern matched multiple scenario files causing all 5 load test scenarios to run simultaneously on first attempt
CodeRabbit described v0.40.1 as 'stability improvements' when it was actually a Windows-only Go toolchain downgrade — misleading review comment
Release Please silently skipped release creation with build commit type — no error, just 'No user facing commits found'
